svg.title: Controller state transitions with the accumulate path and cycle accounting
svg.desc: Synchronous active-low reset takes any state to IDLE. Start is accepted only in IDLE or DONE, with k_len and accumulate sampled at the same edge. A normal start goes to CLEAR; an accumulate start goes straight to COMPUTE, keeping the previous accumulators. CLEAR and CAPTURE each last one cycle. COMPUTE runs steps zero through T minus one, with T equal to k_len plus 2N minus 2. DONE persists until another start.
